record.title: Burgastai–Laoemyao pandemic suspension of road freight, 2021–2022
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.direction: Cross-border freight; mineral exports from Mongolia emphasized.
record.imposing_authority: China–Mongolia border authorities; initial ordering side not identified in retrieved statement.
record.enforcement: Official account describes closure throughout the stated period; October 2021 committee reporting confirms suspended cargo movement.
record.relationship: Promotes R3-EA-L001. Distinct 2021–2022 freight phase, not EA003's passenger regime or 2020 coal closures at Gashuunsukhait/Shiveekhuren.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in the cited reports; no present status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Pandemic-related closure, explicitly stated in Mongolia's foreign-ministry announcement.
record.uncertainty: Exact onset is retrospective official evidence. Reopening concerns freight, not all passenger categories. Individual authority issuing the initial closure is unidentified. Round12 retains potentially contrary September2021 holiday-availability wording and April2021 year-round-status wording. Neither establishes observed freight resumption. Administrative designation versus actual pandemic operation remains unresolved; these sources do not independently verify continuity.

historical.duration_note: Duration withheld after Round15 peer review. The retrospective official closure account supports the reported dates, but unresolved potentially contrary operation notices prevent treating their 482-day difference as a confirmed continuous freight-closure spell. No intervening passage is asserted.
